added.summary: Scroll anchoring (CSS Scroll Anchoring 1): a scroll container scrolled down from its start keeps what it shows in place when content above it grows or shrinks, a chat log or quest list that loads older entries no longer jumps. `overflow-anchor: none` turns it off on a container or keeps a subtree from being the anchor. UI state version 26 saves the anchors; version 25 upgrades with none.
